science_relevance.scientific_problem: Choose irrigation timing and amounts that sustain wheat yield while conserving water.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Water-efficient crop management addresses the competition between agricultural production and limited water resources.

papers.title: AquaCrop modeling to explore optimal irrigation of winter wheat for improving grain yield and water productivity
papers.primary_goal: Determine winter-wheat irrigation schedules that improve grain yield and water productivity under varying weather conditions.
papers.task_relation: The paper directly optimizes wheat irrigation using AquaCrop and weather records. The local policy problem uses the same crop-model family with Tunis weather and its own water budget; it does not validate regional field recommendations or reproduce the paper's sixty-year study.

science_relevance.reason: The supporting paper's main goal is an agricultural water-management decision, rather than introducing the AquaCrop software.
science_relevance.verification_basis: Primary publisher, author, or PubMed/PMC paper abstract and relevant task description inspected on the web; local catalog contract inspected. No independent reproduction of the paper is claimed.
